subject: [PATCH 32/60] cgroup/cpuset: keep spread page cache off private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch author posted the original patch and a duplicate message via B4 Relay, but no other messages have been added to the thread yet.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to optimize the spread of page cache across nodes in a cgroup/cpuset setup, particularly when memory_spread_page is enabled. The goal is to prevent private nodes from being used as preferred nodes for page cache allocation, which can lead to inefficient sharing and extra overhead.
